title: Argon 18 Krypton Pro current all-road family and configurations
notes: Current Krypton Pro page lists up to 40c/43 mm actual clearance for the SRAM Force AXS build, Pro Level carbon layup, TCS, T47, storage, six sizes and USD 8,750. The family page lists the frameset at USD 3,375. Actual clearance varies by drivetrain and fenders.
